summary: Execution completed in 1.3 minutes across 4 experiments. The 1.21-minute Local-SOTA one-shot formal challenge mutation stream was the only compute-bound experiment and the compute leader, but the data does not identify its slow phase. The locked task-level classification reports no compute-bound GPU-idle fault, and no evidence shows 2 or more models running in parallel.
bottlenecks_identified: The Local-SOTA one-shot formal challenge mutation stream led compute time, but the timing data has no phase breakdown, so the cause cannot be assigned.
The GPU snapshot is not linked to an identified task phase, so it cannot establish task-time accelerator efficiency.
No model-count or runner-selection receipt is available, so the record cannot assess DualGPURunner engagement for parallel model work.
improvements_suggested: Add automatic request batching for batchable single-model inference; the GPU report recommends 8–16 questions per forward pass and projects 4–8× throughput.
Capture monotonic phase timings and task-correlated GPU samples around every GGUF, CUDA, or requires-GPU phase.
Record model count and runner selection for each compute task; use DualGPURunner only when 2 or more models are loaded in parallel.
When independent compute jobs are ready together, place a second job on GPU 0 instead of forcing one single-model job across both devices.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Batch 8–16 independent questions per forward pass when the formal-challenge stream exposes a batch.
Emit per-phase timing and task-correlated GPU samples for every compute-bound experiment.
Emit model-count and runner receipts, and schedule a second independent model job on GPU 0 only when concurrent work exists.
meta_reflection: The milestone was already brief, so the main opportunity is to make the single compute path observable and batchable. The 70% estimate is an upper bound: it applies the GPU report's conservative 4× batching projection to the full 1.21-minute compute entry within the 1.3-minute milestone, although the data does not show how much of that entry was batchable inference.
